purpose: Record a second privacy-bounded audit of the locally available hydrogen-station material before using it for further model work.

sampled_candidate_manifest.interpretation: The sampled station candidates contain useful station-side signals. The presence of pressure, temperature, flow-like and state-like fields does not establish vehicle-side or dispenser-boundary semantics.

decision.reason: The local collection is large and supports station-side dynamics, but no independently attested synchronized receiving-vessel/vehicle pressure, temperature, delivered mass or SOC cohort with controller/protocol state was identified.

next_action: Use the station bundle for station-side holdouts and obtain custodian-approved semantic and reuse attestation before fitting flow, temperature or state parameters. Keep the full-loop gate closed until a synchronized vehicle/receptacle cohort is approved.
claim_boundary: This record is an aggregate local-data revalidation. It does not publish raw rows or source identity, attest channel units, validate a vehicle fill, establish a safety limit, or certify operation.
